in_sanskrit.name: Bhole
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhole एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bhole is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhola, which means 'Lord Shiva'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is the god of destruction and regeneration, representing the cycle of life, death, and rebirth.
